Affordable Housing Re-Rental Program

Available rent-stabilized re-rental opportunities in Astoria, Queens.

When a tenant vacates a rent-stabilized unit in a 421-a or 485-x building, that unit remains rent-stabilized and is made available for re-rental. Applicants are processed on a first-come, first-served basis per HPD guidelines. Prospective tenants who meet the income requirements are welcome to apply and join the waitlist.

The lottery is run in cooperation with Sterling23 and the NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD).

Actual rent may vary based on lease terms. A 3% increase applies for one-year leases commencing on or after October 1, 2025, and on or before September 30, 2026. A 4.5% increase applies for two-year leases commencing on or after October 1, 2025, and on or before September 30, 2026.

New York City is committed to the principle of inclusivity in all of its neighborhoods, including supporting New Yorkers to reside in neighborhoods of their choice, regardless of their neighborhood of origin and regardless of the neighborhood into which they want to move.

1182 Ogden Ave - Highbridge, Bronx

1182 Ogden Ave, Bronx, NY 10452

Unit Photos - Apt 6D


Welcome to 1182 Ogden Avenue, a modern residential building located in the vibrant Highbridge neighborhood of the Bronx. This newly constructed         1-bedroom apartment offers contemporary finishes, plenty of natural light, and a thoughtfully designed layout that makes it a comfortable place to call home.

The apartment features a spacious bedroom with generous closet space, an open-concept living and dining area, a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a stylish bathroom with contemporary fixtures. Residents also have access to an elevator, on-site laundry facilities, secure entry, and an on-site superintendent.

Conveniently located near the 4/B/D trains and multiple bus routes, the apartment provides easy access to Manhattan and surrounding neighborhoods. Shopping, restaurants, parks, and other everyday conveniences are also nearby.

  • Elevator
  • In-building laundry
  • Secure entry
  • On-site superintendent
  • Parking available for an additional fee
  • Pet-friendly, subject to approval
  • Near 4/B/D trains
